scripts.export_child.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,time,resource,sys,hashlib,datetime
spec=Path(sys.argv[1]);j=json.loads(spec.read_text());start=time.monotonic()
def now():return datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
out=Path(j['stdout']);assert not out.exists(),'Never repeat an export'
r=dict(start=now(),command=j['command'])
with out.open('w') as f,Path(j['stderr']).open('w') as e:p=subprocess.run(j['command'],stdout=f,stderr=e)
r.update(rc=p.returncode,export_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,export_peak_rss_kib=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss)
Path(j['result']).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
try:
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('llvm-cov exit '+str(p.returncode))
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with out.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 r['output_sha256']=h.hexdigest();r['bytes']=out.stat().st_size
 with out.open() as f:cov=json.load(f)
 r['JSON_parseable']=True
 r['files']=sum(len(z['files']) for z in cov['data'])
 r['functions']=sum(len(z['functions']) for z in cov['data'])
 r['executable_lines']=sum(f['summary']['lines']['count'] for z in cov['data'] for f in z['files'])
 r['covered_lines']=sum(f['summary']['lines']['covered'] for z in cov['data'] for f in z['files'])
 r['totals']=[z['totals'] for z in cov['data']]
 r['format']=cov.get('type');r['version']=cov.get('version')
 r['validation_peak_rss_kib']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
 r['state']='成功'
except BaseException as e:
 r['state']='失败';r['error']=repr(e);raise
finally:
 r['end']=now();r['total_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
 Path(j['result']).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
 print('已结束',now(),r['state'],'ALL-END',flush=True)
